scripts.dev:all: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && concurrently -n server,vite -c blue,green "node dist/server/index.js" "vite"
scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run zip-server
scripts.build-server: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && cp server/README.md dist/server/README.md && cp package.json dist/server/package.json && cp server/start_server.sh dist/server/start_server.sh && chmod +x dist/server/start_server.sh && cp server/kill_server.sh dist/server/kill_server.sh && chmod +x dist/server/kill_server.sh
scripts.zip-server: npm run build-server && ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent dist/server stockworks_server.zip && mv stockworks_server.zip dist/stockworks_server.zip
scripts.predeploy: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.kill-servers: vpids=$(lsof -ti tcp:5173 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$vpids" ] && kill -TERM $vpids 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; vpids=$(lsof -ti tcp:5173 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$vpids" ] && kill -9 $vpids 2>/dev/null; bash server/kill_server.sh; echo 'Vite (port 5173) stopped'
scripts.restart-server: npm run kill-servers && npm run dev:all
